item.title: WA new proposed income tax gains ground
item.description: Washington’s proposed new income tax for people earning more than $1 million a year appears headed toward passage, with Gov. Bob Ferguson saying he’ll sign the latest version of the measure proposed by legislative Democrats.

item.title: Authorities search debris after suspected tornadoes kill six in Michigan and Oklahoma
item.description: UNION CITY, Mich. — Authorities searched through rubble and debris in southern Michigan on Saturday after suspected tornadoes tore through the region and killed four people, including a 12-year-old boy, during powerful storms also blamed for two deaths in eastern Oklahoma.

item.title: Violence in Selma 61 years ago led to Voting Rights Act
item.description: SELMA, Ala. — Sixty-one years after state troopers attacked Civil Rights marchers on the Edmund Pettus Bridge in Selma, thousands gathered in the Alabama city over the weekend amid new concerns about the future of the Voting Rights Act.

item.title: Wilson’s kit housing bill passes both chambers unanimously
item.description: A bill intended to streamline state regulations on kit-built homes has officially cleared both houses of the Washington state Legislature with unanimous support.

item.title: Family bids Rev. Jackson goodbye
item.description: CHICAGO — A day after former presidents, sitting governors and local Chicago residents alike attended a vibrant, televised celebration for the late Rev. Jesse Jackson Sr., the family and friends who knew him best hosted a more intimate gathering Saturday to grieve the civil rights leader at his organization’s headquarters.

item.title: World marks International Women’s Day
item.description: Women across the world called for equal pay, reproductive rights, education, justice and decision-making jobs and celebrated progress toward female empowerment during events marking International Women’s Day on Sunday.

item.title: Iran names Mojtaba Khamenei to succeed his slain father as supreme leader
item.description: DUBAI, United Arab Emirates — Mojtaba Khamenei, the son of Iran's late supreme leader, has been named his successor, Iranian state TV announced early Monday, as the war that began with his father's killing less than two weeks ago took a dramatic turn.

item.title: Members of Washington Air National Guard assisting in Iran war
item.description: Members of the Washington Air National Guard have been activated to support U.S. military action against Iran as part of Operation Epic Fury, a military spokesperson confirmed Friday.

item.title: Drug bust makes Eastern Washington history
item.description: The Drug Enforcement Administration made the largest drug bust in Eastern Washington history when agents last week seized about 370 pounds of narcotics and approximately $2 million in cash as part of a drug-trafficking investigation in the Tri-Cities, according to the U.S. Attorney’s Office in the Eastern District of Washington.

item.title: Scoot Henderson scores 28 points as the Trail Blazers beat the reeling Pacers 131-111
item.description: Scoot Henderson scored a season-high 28 points on 10-of-15 shooting and the Portland Trail Blazers beat the skidding Indiana Pacers 131-111 on Sunday night.
